name: EcoFirst Consolidated Bhd
overview: 今年公司通过两家全资子公司签订买卖协议，拟以4500万令吉收购两幅永久地契土地，并多次获得卖方延长完成期限；并已向Bursa Securities提交上市申请。
overview_en: During the year, the company's two wholly-owned subsidiaries entered into sale and purchase agreements to acquire two pieces of freehold land for a total cash consideration of RM45 million, with several extensions of time granted by the vendors; it also proposed the issuance of up to 70 million new 5% redeemable convertible preference shares (RCPS) and submitted the listing application to Bursa Securities.

segments.name: 产业发展
segments.note: 今年主要通过子公司推进土地收购，以补充发展用地。
segments.note_en: This year, mainly through subsidiaries, the segment progressed land acquisitions to replenish development land bank.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 卖方以书面同意就上述土地收购协议再给予进一步延长期限。
actions.text_en: The vendors agreed in writing to grant a further extension of time for the land acquisition agreements.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 卖方同意就上述土地收购协议给予进一步延长期限。
actions.text_en: The vendors agreed to grant a further extension of time for the land acquisition agreements.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司EcoFirst Homes Sdn. Bhd.和EcoFirst Living Sdn. Bhd.于2026年1月30日与Prisma Bumiraya Sdn. Bhd.（接管人及管理人获委任）（清盘中）及Akasia Dimensi Sdn.
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiaries EcoFirst Homes Sdn. Bhd. and EcoFirst Living Sdn. Bhd. entered into sale and purchase agreements on 30 January 2026 with Prisma Bumiraya Sdn. Bhd. (Receivers and Managers Appointed) (in Liquidation) and Akasia Dimensi Sdn. Bhd.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note_en: This year, proposed RCPS issuance with listing application submitted, and there was a material litigation.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 就上述RCPS发行及章程修改的上市申请已于2026年10月29日提交予Bursa Securities。
actions.text_en: The listing application in relation to the proposed RCPS issuance and constitution amendments was submitted to Bursa Securities on 29 October 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 公司与Advance Opportunities Fund及Advance Opportunities Fund I签订有条件认购协议。
actions.text_en: The company entered into a conditional subscription agreement with Advance Opportunities Fund and Advance Opportunities Fund I to undertake the proposed issuance of up to 70,000,000 new 5% redeemable convertible preference shares (RCPS) at an issue price of RM…

actions.title: MATERIAL LITIGATION
actions.text: 公司公告一宗重大诉讼。
actions.text_en: The company announced a material litigation.
